title: WHIL’s Picture of The Week
content:
18th February 2015

We’re back into the archives this week.

Brother and Bones have been stomping around stages all over Europe and the US for a number of years now, with their huge live performances, while releasing a flurry of EP’s & fine tuning their sound along the way. This is the year they finally head into the studio to record their début album, which is a long awaited addition for all Brother and Bones fans.

This image was shot at Lubstock Festival a few years back of Brother and Bones lead singer, Rich Thomas.

As always, we’re interested in getting our reader photos as Photo of the Week. If you have any images you’d like to share with the world (well, mainly Bristol) please send them to contact@thefixmagazine.com with the subject ‘Photo of the week’.

Will Fahy
